title: Every Maximizing Permuton of a Nontrivial Layered Pattern Is Layered
description: Working paper answering Problem 3 of Kabela, Král’, Noel and Pierron (2022) for every layered target pattern of order at least two. Every density-maximizing permuton is layered, including when the target has consecutive singleton layers. The proof transfers labelled rooted completions by a two-point variation, then replaces inversion-span components. It does not assert finite-order equality, uniqueness in general, or a uniform layer-count bound. AI-assisted and internally reviewed; not externally peer reviewed.
